channel_intelligence.suno_rules: Data-backed prompt rules, updated 2026-10-05: (1) ALWAYS 'instrumental / no vocals'. (2) KEEP ENERGY CONSISTENT, no dynamic spikes - Suggested is now 98.3% of long-form watch hours and those sessions end the moment a track jumps. (3) SEASON THE TITLE AND PROMPT TOGETHER - three straight autumn-titled longs each got a distribution week right after publish; write the season into the mood ('cozy autumn cafe', 'rainy grey afternoon', 'quiet library autumn') so audio and title match. (4) NEW - PUBLISH CADENCE BEATS STYLE LOYALTY. Piano Trio and Soft Bossa longs performed statistically even this week (14 views/425 impr vs 11 views/112 impr); the real driver is how recently the video published. Alternate styles freely as long as a new autumn-hook long goes out every Mon/Thu. (5) HIGH-CTR TITLE PATTERN WORTH TESTING - 'Quiet Library...Cozy Autumn Jazz for Calm Days' pulled 5.9% CTR, 3x the channel average; try 'Library'/'Calm Days' framing on more thumbnails. (6) VARY RUNTIME 75-120 MINUTES on longs rather than defaulting to one fixed length; the 91-minute Rainy Paris long logged a 30:50 AVD (33.6% of runtime), the best watch efficiency yet. (7) NAME THE ACTION AND MATCH SEARCH - search volume is thin (4 views this week) so don't over-index on query wording; Suggested placement matters far more right now. (8) STILL WITHDRAWN - caption rules; captions remain noise on 6+ weeks of data. (9) NEW 10/05 - NIGHT/AFTERNOON + AUTUMN framing gave the two best watch-time longs (Rainy Paris 1.0h from 6 views; Late Night 0.8h from 15); prompt 'late night' or 'grey afternoon' moods. (10) NEW - one long missed = ~1 week of Suggested lost (138 views vs 192); batch-render ahead.
